meta.name: Love Is Blind, Habibi
meta.description: Celebrity couple Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali host this social experiment, where Arab singles connect and commit to marriage — before meeting face-to-face.

videos.title: The Pods Are Open Habibi
videos.overview: First impressions mean everything when a diverse group of eligible Arab singles are introduced for the first time — completely sight unseen.

videos.title: It's Complicated
videos.overview: Only a handful of dates in, and a few couples are already ready to pop the big question. They say, "when you know, you know" — but do they really?

videos.title: Surprise, Surprise!
videos.overview: Chafic flirts his way to charm a few promising connections, but the women aren't happy when they find out that he has eyes for more than one of them.

videos.title: Catching Up with Cupid
videos.overview: The next phase heats up as the engaged couples exit the pods and meet in a group setting. Two people recognize each other from outside the show.

videos.title: The Aftermath
videos.overview: The couples finally get to know each other one-on-one. While some find a deeper connection, others discover things they really wish they hadn't.

videos.title: Realityville
videos.overview: With their phones back in their hands, the couples return to real life, turning to friends and family to give their blessings — but will they get it?

videos.title: Family Matters
videos.overview: Familiar faces crash a night out on the town, taking the couples by surprise. The parents help progress some engagements, while others instill doubt.

videos.title: Almost There
videos.overview: The big day is fast approaching. The women become emotional selecting the perfect fairytale dress, while the men bond over pre-wedding traditions.

videos.title: Tying the Knot... Or Not?
videos.overview: The moment of truth is here. As vows are declared for the whole world to hear, will the couples leave heartbroken or with a soulmate by their side?

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Sparks fly as celebrity couple Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali revisit key moments in a reunion packed with intense drama — and a surprise couple revelation.

videos.title: Habibi, the Pods Are Open... Again
videos.overview: Hosts Wissam Breidy and Rym Saidi open the pods to a new group of Arab hearts. As sparks fly, one connection feels like fate. Could doubt get in the way?

videos.title: The One or No One
videos.overview: As knees begin to bend, the couples face their first hurdle: meeting in person. One participant questions whether he can handle this journey to love.

videos.title: Copy, Paste, Caught!
videos.overview: After a bride-to-be makes a shocking heart decision, one bubbly hopeful faces doubts about her sincerity when her suitors compare notes on their dates.

videos.title: When One Door Closes
videos.overview: As some connections begin to bloom, others start to wilt. After meeting his to-be-bride in person, one man struggles to weigh his dreams against reality.

videos.title: Red Flags Ahead
videos.overview: The engaged couples head to a resort to grow their connections. One bride can't reconcile the voice she fell for in the pods with the man before her.

videos.title: The Honeymoon's Over
videos.overview: One hopeful heart seeks a second chance. Conflict brews around a groom's uncouth comments. The couples return to Dubai to meet their families.

videos.title: Meet the... In-laws?
videos.overview: While one groom reinforces his devotion to his fiancée, others face harsh criticism from their nearest and dearest. Will they risk it all for love?

videos.title: Against All Odds
videos.overview: Wissam and Rym join the brides and grooms-to-be as they shop for their wedding clothes. As the big day approaches, one couple crumbles under the pressure.

videos.title: Questions Before Forever
videos.overview: The wedding days have arrived. Will the remaining couples take the leap toward happily ever after — and prove once and for all that love is truly blind?

videos.title: Wedding Bells or Alarm Bells?
videos.overview: The wedding days have arrived. Will the remaining couples take the leap toward happily ever after — and prove once and for all that love is truly blind?
